notes.title: Mysterious Planet Update - UFO Laser!
notes.notes:
[h1]A new threat from above![/h1]
[h2]UFO Laser[/h2]
[list]
[*] The UFO on the Mysterious Planet map is now armed with a deadly laser beam
[*] The laser roams randomly across the center of the map
[*] Any AI caught in the beam is instantly eliminated
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] The killfeed now clearly displays "Lightning" and "Laser" when AIs are eliminated by those hazards
[*] Special map events now begin when 14 AIs remain instead of 12
[/list]

notes.title: Shocking Update! Lightning System Added⚡
notes.notes:
[h2]New Lightning System[/h2]
[h3]Introducing lightning: a powerful new threat in the storm![/h3]
[list]
[*] AI's are now vulnerable to lightning strikes — stay clear, or watch them drop!
[*] ⚡ Now active on the [b]Summer Forest[/b] (when 12 or fewer players remain) and [b]Haunted Swamp[/b] maps (always active)
[/list]
[h2]Summer Forest Minor Visual Change[/h2]
[list]
[*]The sky becomes cloudier when the storm begins
[/list]

notes.title: May 2025 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an option to adjust the menu music volume
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[h2]Streamer Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game now displays a text message (top right, yellow) when a viewer joins a match
[*] If a viewer who is already in the match attempts to join again, a message (top right, orange) will be displayed to inform them
[*] Updated some UI in the Streamer menu
[/list]

notes.title: Optimization & bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[h3]Optimized some generated maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players should expect [b]up to 110% more performance on some generated winter maps[/b]
[*] Players should expect [b]up to 90% more performance on some generated autumn maps[/b]
[*] Players should expect [b]up to 7% more performance on some generated summer maps[/b]
[/list]
[h1]"Bug" fixes[/h1]
[h3]Leaderboard[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Normal mode, you can now access the match leaderboard even if you finish in first place! (Believe it or not, previously the leaderboard was not visible if your AI won the Battle Royale. 😅)
[/list]

notes.title: Level max Increase, Normal Mode Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Levels + XP[/h2]
[b]Level max increased from 10 to 15[/b]
[h3]XP total to reach levels[/h3]
level 2 -> 250 to [b]80 XP[/b]
level 3 -> 600 to [b]180 XP[/b]
level 4 -> 1100 to [b]320 XP[/b]
level 5 -> 2000 to [b]520 XP[/b]
level 6 -> 3200 to [b]850 XP[/b]
level 7 -> 4800 to [b]1350 XP[/b]
level 8 -> 6800 to [b]2150 XP[/b]
level 9 -> 9300 to [b]3300 XP[/b]
level 10 -> 14 000 to [b]4800 XP[/b]
level 11 -> [b]6800 XP[/b]
level 12 -> [b]9600 XP[/b]
level 13 -> [b]13 200 XP[/b]
level 14 -> [b]18 000 XP[/b]
level 15 -> [b]25 000 XP[/b]

[h2]When your AI kills another AI, time on your cooldown will be reduced[/h2]
If your AI gets a kill while you are not controlling it, the time of your cooldown for your ult will be reduced.

This change is made so [b]people can control their AI faster if their AI is doing a good job (Getting kills)[/b].

[h2]Text on top of the AI's should now be clearer[/h2]

[h2]Max AI's per match is now depending on your level[/h2]
[b]The more you level up, the more AI's you can face[/b]

[h2]Several bug fixes[/h2]

notes.title: End of Match Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
[h2]End of Match Leaderboard[/h2]
The skin (Country) of each AI is now shown in the End of Match Leaderboard for the Normal & Streamer Modes

[h2]Streamer Mode Change[/h2]
If a viewer select a random skin, while the streamer has selected multiple AI's per viewer, each AI of the same viewer will all have the same random skin

notes.title: Added random map picker + Streamer mode menu Update
notes.notes:
-New random map picker ! Let the map be random !
-Streamers do not need to re enter their name at every match like before, it will now autofill based on the previous match !
-Max AI per viewer is now 6 instead of 5 !
-Added South Korea flag !
-Fixed camera bug when switching from Control cam to Free cam

notes.title: Update 1.3 - New Map !
notes.notes:
-Added a new map that takes place at the heart of a mysterious planet !
-Removed grass in Streamer Mode so it doesn't make the livestream pixelated
-Added the option to change the grass density
